scheme_name: Indira Mahila Shakti Udyam Protsahan Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Rajasthan
The applicant’s self‑help group or cluster/federation must be registered under any department of the state government; clusters/federations must be registered under the Cooperative Act
Eligibility category noted in source: widows
Eligibility category noted in source: abandoned women
Eligibility category noted in source: victims of violence
Eligibility category noted in source: disabled women
benefits_summary: Provides women entrepreneurs in Rajasthan with loans up to ₹50  lakh for individuals and up to ₹1  crore for self‑help groups, along with margin money of 25‑30% of the sanctioned amount.
